decision: Use the durably reserved retained H200 for one mutable discovery claim that implements and measures a materially independent QKV projection to Q/K normalization, RoPE, layout, and first-attention-consumer boundary.
causal_hypothesis: At exact decode concurrency 32, materialized Q/K intermediates plus normalization, RoPE, layout conversion, and their launches form avoidable data movement and synchronization after the QKV projection. A source-matched epilogue or dataflow boundary can preserve the pinned consumer while reducing launches or materialized bytes.
stock_control: The installed pinned-runtime QKV projection followed by its exact Q/K normalization, RoPE, layout, and first attention consumer at mechanically extracted local/global Gemma geometry.

allowed: Project-local discovery runner, CUDA or Triton source, build files, launcher glue, runtime API adapters, instrumentation, and artifact retrieval.
The smallest source-justified epilogue, fusion, or dataflow change spanning the QKV projection output through the same first attention consumer.
In-place repair of ordinary compile, import, path, permission, runtime API, layout, and telemetry defects under the same claim.
frozen: Model and checkpoint identities, runtime and image identities, decode-c32 workload, producer and consumer semantics, stock control, numerical gate, timing boundary, and one decision-bearing candidate decomposition.
No endpoint submission, checkpoint mutation, architecture deletion, quality proxy, or reuse of gated-activation timing as evidence.

experiment_contract.first_call: After claiming, inspect the installed pinned producer/consumer source and exact model config, record symbols, shapes, strides, dtypes, head geometry, scale and RoPE conventions, then make the smallest real H200 producer-to-consumer call. This is the execution-equivalent discovery smoke test.

quality_gate.required: Exact tensor identities and geometry; finite outputs; stock and candidate reach the same first attention consumer; consumer-output relative-L2 <= max(0.002, 2x the measured same-process stock A/A envelope).
quality_gate.structural_failures: Any nonfinite output, wrong shape/stride/ownership, missing candidate-path proof, or different consumer is invalid rather than a performance result.

experiment_contract.performance_gate: Correctness before timing. Measure profiler-off alternating warm stock/candidate repetitions at the exact shape, report distributions and uncertainty when practical, and retain any reproducible gain with a credible whole-request bound; no arbitrary minimum percentage applies.
experiment_contract.physical_prediction: Before timing, state one falsifiable prediction for launches, materialized bytes, L2/HBM traffic, or synchronization and report the observed counter or exact analytical bound.

lifecycle.release_condition: Release generation-fenced only after a complete positive or negative component terminal, an unsafe or unreachable guest, or the absolute release deadline. Recoverable pre-science defects retain the claim for bounded in-place repair.

artifact_contract: A compact typed observation-to-opportunity register with uncertainty, competing explanation, modifiable fraction, falsifier, and expected information per dollar.
Exact extracted geometry and installed producer/consumer symbols plus immutable identity evidence.
Every discovery attempt with pre-science/science attribution, source hashes, stdout/stderr, and repair lineage.

One terminal containing stock/candidate consumed-output correctness, candidate-path proof, warm timing rows, physical prediction versus observation, useful GPU seconds, full claim exposure, and generation-fenced release evidence.
must: Read this binding once, verify its SHA-256, the exact durable $3 reservation, available bench, strict SSH identity, and active r9 watchdog, then execute the claim command by 17:09Z.
Use sudo -n docker for Nebius Docker commands, reuse the pinned image/checkpoint/caches, and keep mutable implementation and repairs inside this project and claim.
Publish active_session last if a durable controller owner must outlive the researcher turn; otherwise keep the foreground claim through terminal and release.
must_not: Do not call provider lifecycle, replace or stop the watchdog, claim another bench, mutate another project, replay gated-activation science, or run endpoint traffic.
Do not release for an ordinary pre-science integration failure while safe repair time remains, and do not retain the claim after 17:55Z.
